schema: functions: name -> file, orig, size_orig, status (open, exact), kind, callers, note (by hand: an odd source form, a guessed name, dead code).
compiler: ccv1r (ccv1: the ?: of putc and getc without the frame temporaries; ccv1q as ccv1r; OLD_D67 for cput)

main.note: rewritten by WEGA (from the code): name = argv[0]; hd by strcmp(argv[0], "hd") (conv 010, max 4, base 16); options reset conv; o sets base 8, x/h base 16; the message "%s: cannot open %s" with the name; exit(1).

cput.note: exact with v1r OLD_D67 (2026-11-24): the idle r7 of the parameter goes back before c &= 0377 takes a word, so r2 (the split rr2) as in the original.

putn.note: the source of System III (if (d > 9) ... else ...); the original places the inline putc of the else branch inside the then branch and shares its inc (block order / tail merging of the optimizer); if (d < 10) swaps the branches but not the layout.
